visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera zooms into a computer monitor showing a small animated yellow rabbit character with long ears running across the bottom taskbar of a Windows desktop. (2) Cut to a young woman with short curly hair in a bright office environment. She is wearing a grey plaid shirt and points a finger toward the camera while speaking. A male colleague is visible in the background at his desk. (3) A hand drops a silver coin into the woman's open palm. (4) The screen shifts to a recording of a website with an orange-and-black fire aesthetic and the words '免費資源區'. (5) A technical walkthrough follows, showing a Windows file explorer window navigating through folders related to 'chiikawa'. The cursor clicks on a Java installation file and then a 'Shimeji' application file. (6) A character selection menu appears on screen with Japanese text and checkboxes next to small icons of various cartoon characters. The user selects multiple characters. (7) Several small animated cartoon figures fall from the top of the desktop screen and land on open windows. (8) The cursor interacts with the characters by dragging them or right-clicking to reveal context menus with Japanese and Chinese options. (9) The woman reappears in the office, smiling playfully at the camera as it zooms in on her face.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 欸妳的桌面怎麼有烏薩奇在跑. (2) [Subtitle]: 這是我的桌面小寵物啊. (3) [Subtitle]: 想學嗎? 給我五塊錢我就教你. (4) [Variety]: 請查閱資訊欄. [Slogan]: 免費資源區. (5) [Slogan]: Youtube無廣告. 桌面寵物吉卡哇. 到免費網路資源. (6) [Subtitle]: 首先用你的 Windows 電腦開啟風火的網站. (7) [Subtitle]: 找到桌面寵物吉卡哇然後下載. (8) [Subtitle]: 接著打開你下載的檔案. (9) [Subtitle]: 先安裝 Java. (10) [Subtitle]: 再來找到 Shimeji 這個檔案. (11) [Subtitle]: 然後選擇要叫誰出來. (12) [Subtitle]: 目前只有四個角色可以選擇. (13) [Subtitle]: 小可愛們就會從天而降啦. (14) [Subtitle]: 平常除了可以按住滑鼠把他們丟來丟去以外. (15) [Subtitle]: 對角色按右鍵還能給他們下指令做出不同的動作. (16) [Subtitle]: 在工具列對圖示按右鍵就能調整設定. (17) [Subtitle]: 可以調整語言或是把他們變大. (18) [Subtitle]: 但我覺得還是原本大小最可愛啦. (19) [Subtitle]: 那我的 Mac 也可以裝嗎.
